name: io.github.idss-mesa/ameriflux-mcp
title: AmeriFlux and FLUXNET
description: AmeriFlux and FLUXNET flux tower data: sites, availability, variables, citations and previews.

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: AmeriFlux username, sent to site PIs with a consented download (downloads only).

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_USER_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email registered with AmeriFlux, sent with a consented download (downloads only).

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_USER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional name shown to site PIs with a download.

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_INTENDED_USE
environmentVariables.description: Intended-use category: 1 synthesis, 2 model, 3 remote sensing, 4 other research, 5 education, 6 other.

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_DESCRIPTION
environmentVariables.description: How you will use the data, in your own words (20-1000 characters); sent to site PIs.

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_MCP_IDENTITY__IS_TEST
environmentVariables.description: true for test download requests, false for real ones; downloads refuse until set.

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_MCP_DOWNLOADS__ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: true to offer the consented download tool; off by default.

environmentVariables.name: AMERIFLUX_MCP_LOCAL__ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated extra folders the local file tools may read (e.g. FLUXNET2015 zips).
